name: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech(Group)Co.,Ltd
summary: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech(Group)Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells civil explosives. The company's products include expanded ammonium nitrate explosives, emulsion explosives, industrial electronic detonators, detonating cord detonators, plastic detonating cords, industrial detonating cords, and on-site mixed explosives; and industrial explosives, detonators, and cables.
